Summarise a fit

Source: R/summary.R
summary.kb_fit.Rd

A model fit's metadata paired with a per-term posterior summary table.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'kb_fit'
summary(
  object,
  ...,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  estimate = stats::median,
  sig_fig = 3,
  include_random_effects = FALSE,
  rhat = 1.01,
  ess = 100
)

Arguments

object

A kb_fit object.

...

These dots are for future extensions and must be empty.

conf_level

A number greater than 0 and less than 1 giving the compatibility-interval level.

estimate

A function that reduces a numeric vector of posterior draws to a single estimate, such as median or mean.

sig_fig

A whole number of significant figures for summary output.

include_random_effects

A flag specifying whether to include the group-level random-effect terms in the output.

rhat

A number giving the maximum acceptable Rhat.

ess

A number giving the minimum acceptable bulk and tail effective sample size per chain.

Value

A summary_kb_fit object: a list of fit metadata and a coefficients tibble with columns term, estimate, lower, upper, rhat, ess_bulk, ess_tail, and converged.

Details

The printed summary adds the sampler diagnostics (divergent transitions, maximum treedepth, and E-BFMI). A term's converged uses the Rhat and effective sample size thresholds of kb_converged(); the fit's verdict also covers the group-level deviations and divergent transitions, so it can be FALSE when every term shown has converged.

See also

Other fit methods: augment.kb_fit(), coef.kb_fit(), fitted.kb_fit(), glance.kb_fit(), kb_model_describe(), kb_samples(), kb_stancode(), log_lik.kb_fit(), posterior_epred.kb_fit(), posterior_linpred.kb_fit(), posterior_predict.kb_fit(), prior_summary.kb_fit(), residuals.kb_fit(), tidy.kb_fit()

Examples

summary(fit_weight_sim_nereo)
#> <summary_kb_fit>
#> Model:     Weight (Nereocystis luetkeana)
#> Predictor: diameter_mm, reference 24.9 (geometric mean)
#> Data:      660 observations; groups: site (6), year (6), site:year (33)
#> Draws:     3 chains, 500 post-warmup draws each (thin = 4), 1500 total
#> Converged: TRUE
#> 
#> # A tibble: 7 × 8
#>   term           estimate    lower  upper  rhat ess_bulk ess_tail converged
#>   <chr>             <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl> <lgl>    
#> 1 intercept       -0.666  -0.918   -0.421  1        1399     1217 TRUE     
#> 2 diameter_power   2.92    2.71     3.13   1.00     1399     1345 TRUE     
#> 3 weight_floor     0.118   0.098    0.14   1.00     1395     1318 TRUE     
#> 4 sd_site          0.2     0.0406   0.521  1.00      733      589 TRUE     
#> 5 sd_year          0.0544  0.00298  0.254  1.00     1117     1457 TRUE     
#> 6 sd_site_year     0.261   0.179    0.372  1        1082     1460 TRUE     
#> 7 sd_residual      0.463   0.438    0.488  1        1348     1425 TRUE     
#> 
#> estimate: posterior point estimate; lower, upper: 95% compatibility limits.
#> rhat: potential scale reduction factor (1 at convergence).
#> ess_bulk, ess_tail: bulk and tail effective sample sizes.
#> converged: rhat below 1.01 and ess_bulk, ess_tail at least 100 per chain.
#> 0% divergent transitions; 0% max-treedepth; min E-BFMI 1.6.

# Looser thresholds, for a quick exploratory fit:
summary(fit_weight_sim_nereo, rhat = 1.05, ess = 50)
#> <summary_kb_fit>
#> Model:     Weight (Nereocystis luetkeana)
#> Predictor: diameter_mm, reference 24.9 (geometric mean)
#> Data:      660 observations; groups: site (6), year (6), site:year (33)
#> Draws:     3 chains, 500 post-warmup draws each (thin = 4), 1500 total
#> Converged: TRUE
#> 
#> # A tibble: 7 × 8
#>   term           estimate    lower  upper  rhat ess_bulk ess_tail converged
#>   <chr>             <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl> <lgl>    
#> 1 intercept       -0.666  -0.918   -0.421  1        1399     1217 TRUE     
#> 2 diameter_power   2.92    2.71     3.13   1.00     1399     1345 TRUE     
#> 3 weight_floor     0.118   0.098    0.14   1.00     1395     1318 TRUE     
#> 4 sd_site          0.2     0.0406   0.521  1.00      733      589 TRUE     
#> 5 sd_year          0.0544  0.00298  0.254  1.00     1117     1457 TRUE     
#> 6 sd_site_year     0.261   0.179    0.372  1        1082     1460 TRUE     
#> 7 sd_residual      0.463   0.438    0.488  1        1348     1425 TRUE     
#> 
#> estimate: posterior point estimate; lower, upper: 95% compatibility limits.
#> rhat: potential scale reduction factor (1 at convergence).
#> ess_bulk, ess_tail: bulk and tail effective sample sizes.
#> converged: rhat below 1.05 and ess_bulk, ess_tail at least 50 per chain.
#> 0% divergent transitions; 0% max-treedepth; min E-BFMI 1.6.
